guitar.modelsText: Fender Stratocaster (Blackmore) / Music Man Steve Morse signature
guitar.evidence: Ritchie Blackmore's scalloped-fretboard Fender Stratocaster is extremely well documented; Steve Morse's Music Man signature model is also well known for his later tenure.
guitar.notes: Upgraded confidence from medium to high given how iconic Blackmore's Strat use is.

tone.summary: A tight, crunchy signal chain utilizing a Boost for attack, Distortion for core grit, followed by the UK 45 amp model and UK Vintage 4x12 cab to emulate classic Marshall Plexi tones. Minimal effects are used to maintain dryness and punch.
corrections: make it more dry and punchy

rig.name: Deep Purple - Highway Star - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up hum and background noise inherent in high-gain rock tones.
blocks.gap: None. Standard practice for aggressive rock sounds.

blocks.purpose: Provide the required 'fast bite' and slight drive boost for riff attack without excessive gain.
blocks.gap: None. Boost is ideal for adding controlled grit/attack.

blocks.purpose: Establish the core hard-rock crunch and grit required for 'Highway Star' era tones.
blocks.gap: The specific Plexi tone might require a dedicated model, but Distortion provides the necessary mid-focused saturation.

blocks.purpose: Enhance the 'bright upper mids' and punchiness while keeping the tone focused and dry.
blocks.gap: None. Used to sculpt the specific frequency response needed for classic rock bite.

blocks.purpose: Emulate the classic British Marshall Plexi sound (JMP era) required for early 70s hard rock.
blocks.gap: None. This is the canonical choice for this genre/era.

blocks.purpose: Provide the classic British cabinet sound and necessary punch for the hard rock tone.
Keep the tone dry and punchy; Wah is explicitly avoided for the main riffing.
blocks.gap: The requirement was 'no wah on riff', so this module is included but deactivated to fulfill the chain length rule while adhering to the musical verdict.

blocks.purpose: Add a subtle sense of space and dimension without creating a 'delay wash' or excessive reverb.
blocks.gap: The verdict asks to reduce delay/reverb, so the mix is kept very low. Room provides natural decay better than Plate for this style.

blocks.purpose: Included for completeness but kept inactive to strictly adhere to the 'avoid delay wash' rule.
blocks.gap: The verdict explicitly avoids excessive delay, so this module is present but bypassed/set to minimum effect.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism by swapping the current IR for a more vintage/open-air 4x12 model.

proposals.reason: Enhance Plexi era punch and openness, reducing the 'boxy' sound of the current cab.
